title: Less is More: Improving LLM Alignment via Preference Data Selection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of preference data selection for LLM alignment using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). It addresses algorithmic issues like parameter shrinkage and proposes a Bayesian Aggregation strategy. While it utilizes the Anthropic Helpful and Harmless dataset for evaluation, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary research goal.
